cases.rationale: Several actual elephants are identifiable by their large ears, wrinkled bodies, legs and long trunks. The ground, rocks and unpotted vegetation contain no other identifiable category object. I considered all 75 definitions, including the distinction between actual elephants and representations; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The locomotive and connected freight cars on rails identify an actual train. The bright lamps belong to the locomotive, rather than an identifiable traffic-control signal, and the poles alone do not establish traffic lights. No actual person is discernible in the dark cab windows. I considered every one of the 75 definitions across the entire crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The yellow painted cast-metal dome, bolts and hydrant body are identifiable parts of an actual fire hydrant. The curved cap is not a bowl or drinking vessel; the raised lettering does not constitute a separate category object. All 75 definitions were considered over the complete crop, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

The monochrome close-up shows identifiable heavy locomotive parts: curved riveted bodywork, linkage, chains and the front coupling/buffer assembly. These support actual train presence. The chains and mechanical pieces are not bicycle parts, scissors or eating utensils, and there is no identifiable human part. I considered all 75 frozen definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The field is covered with orange pumpkins, identified by their ribbed squash shapes and stems amid dry vines. They are not orange fruit, apples, carrots or any other listed food. The plants grow on the ground without pots. I explicitly considered all 75 definitions over the whole crop and found none present, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual long-haired cat lies beside an open laptop with its integrated keyboard, and a computer mouse sits on a mouse pad. A small clear bottle with a narrow neck is visible at the upper edge behind the laptop. The transparent cylindrical tumbler holding stationery remains a recognizable cup, and the colored loop handles with paired blades identify scissors. The curved woven/slatted brown object behind the cat could be a chair back, but too little supporting structure is visible to determine chair identity, so chair is unclear. The desktop is a work surface rather than a dining table; the laptop screen is not a standalone TV. Other pen-like items lack toothbrush bristles, and the partly visible rectangular object at upper left lacks identifiable bound-book evidence. All 75 definitions were considered; chair is the unresolved category.

The pointed ears, muzzle, blue eye and curled furry body identify an actual husky-type dog. It rests on dark upholstered seating, but the tight crop does not reliably distinguish a single-person armchair from a sofa; chair and couch therefore remain unclear. The upholstery does not establish bed context, and the background railing is not a bench. All 75 definitions were considered; the chair-versus-couch distinction is the unresolved ambiguity.

A person on the tennis court holds an identifiable strung tennis racket, and several actual passenger cars are visible behind the fence. The white vehicle near the right background is too obscured to distinguish passenger vehicle from pickup/truck, leaving truck unclear. Green horizontal structures at the right behind the player suggest a court bench but do not expose enough seat/back structure for a definite identification, so bench is unclear. Tennis balls are visible but are not one of these 75 categories. I considered every definition across the crop; truck and bench are the unresolved categories.

The large scissors have two open cutting blades, a central pivot and black handle loops. The square beneath them is a layered decorative fabric/craft piece on a gridded cutting mat, without book binding, dining-table context or an identifiable plate/bowl. Its printed and sewn patterns do not establish actual depicted objects. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

An open bound book and a small closed red book lie on the work desk. A standalone dark monitor qualifies as TV under the definition; the open laptop and its visible integrated keyboard qualify separately, and a computer mouse is on the black pad. The slim objects nearby are pens/writing implements and a clear pen case, without identifiable knife, fork, spoon, remote or toothbrush structure. This is a computer/work desk rather than a dining table. I considered all 75 definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The prominent yellow fixture has a domed hydrant body and capped side outlet, identifying an actual fire hydrant. The buildings and tower behind it show no clock face in this crop, and the upright red and white roadside structures are not identifiable parking meters or traffic signals. I considered all 75 definitions over the whole crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The large blue airliner nose, cockpit, fuselage and engine identify an actual airplane; other aircraft are also visible at the airport. Actual workers are visible beside the plane. The white vehicle at left has a truck cab/body and attached raised airport-service platform, supporting truck presence. Terminal structures and aircraft markings do not create additional actual category objects, and the service platform is not a bench or dining table. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.
